clips.title: The story
paras: At Brewnall Village, Marleth Barleybrew works to prove her family’s ale can rival Thunder Ale. Frustrated by the Thunderbrew clan’s hold on the local beer trade, she schemes to put Barleybrew brew before drinkers.

In Dun Morogh, beer matters as much as steel, and the Barleybrew and Thunderbrew families have long been rivals. Ragnar Thunderbrew and his kin control nearly all the trade from their distillery in Kharanos, to Marleth Barleybrew’s frustration. She believes her family’s brew is just as strong. Rather than challenge the Thunderbrews openly, Marleth turns to quiet tricks. She recruits travelers to secretly replace Kharanos tavern casks with Barleybrew kegs.
